text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The Slovak parliament starts its session on Tuesday with some 22 points on the agenda, including the government's proposed corporate revitalisation law and the law on non-investment funds.
- Czech Moravia Steel is expected to gain a 29.5 percent stake in Slovak iron-casting works Oravske Ferozliatinove Zavody (OFZ).
- Deputy Finance Minister Peter Stanek and the Slovak Association of Securities Traders are expected to discuss the current problems of the Slovak capital market.
PRAVDA - Aircraft repair firm Letecke Opravovne Trencin is preparing to launch helicopter production soon, possibly with a foreign partner.
- OVP Orava, Slovakia's second largest television set producer, is planning at least to double last year's output of 43,000 units this year.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovak statistical institute Infostat has forecast Slovak gross domestic product (GDP) growth of 6.3 percent this year, 60 basis points higher than the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR).
- Chemical producer Duslo Sala and Czech Chemaprojekt Praha have signed a delivery contract for a nitric acid production line.

SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - The Slovak government is scheduled to meet on Tuesday at a regular session, with one economic point on the agenda -- assessment of strategy in transformation of fridge maker Calex a.s..
- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar and a group of leading Slovak companies have scheduled an official visit to France on March 19-20.
